task: Draft or shorten an email or a memo
review: The sender reads the whole text and owns every sentence

task: Summarize a published report or a meeting note
review: The reader checks every figure in the summary against the source

task: Translate a published text between the organization's languages
review: A speaker of the target language reads the translation before it is used

task: Explain a term or a method in plain language
review: The explanation is checked against the methods note before it is repeated

task: Decide anything about a respondent or a member of staff
review: Stays with the person; no assistant is used

task: Draft a missing description or keywords for a catalog record
review: The curator approves the draft before it enters the record

task: Propose a variable label from a questionnaire text
review: Local assistant only; the curator checks the label against the questionnaire

task: Explain why a record failed an edit rule
review: Local assistant only; the editor decides the case

task: Draft a method note from a specification
review: The methodologist checks every formula and reference

task: Draft commentary from a published or embargoed table
review: Every number is checked against the table before approval

task: Write or review a script in Python or R
review: The analyst runs the script on test data and reads the diff

task: Draft a user-facing answer from published values
review: Every number and citation is checked against the record

task: Classify incoming user requests by topic
review: A sample is reviewed each month

task: Draft an agenda or minutes from notes
review: The manager reads and corrects the text before it is sent

task: Approve a publication or a release
review: Stays with the person; no assistant is used

task: Explain a log message or an error
review: The explanation is tested before a change is made
